thread:
oliver: FYI canary rollout 2026-04-model-v3 -> v4 is tripping smart-routing fallbacks. Alerts show sticky fallbacks binding to eu-west variant and latency spikes. not sure if it's model mismatch or policy bug. paging @sre-oncall :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager: smart-routing.fallback_rate(/v4) > 40% over 5m; affected route: /api/generate; error_type: variant-incompatible (504/502 mix)
sre-oncall: On it. can you paste the canary config?
oliver: putting snippet — the rollout policy is "canary: 5%" with sticky_fallback: true and fallback_policy: "same-region-preferred"
maya: quick note — we recently upgraded variant fingerprinting so a failing runtime could appear "incompatible" and trigger fallback. sticky_fallback TTL is 15m by default, so once a session binds it's sticky.
sre-oncall: That explains the persistence. We need to prevent new sessions from inheriting the bad fallback while we triage. Immediate mitigation: pause the rollout and drain canary tokens.
oliver: pausing rollout now via console... done. canary percentage -> 0 :white_check_mark:
eng-runner: I can push a runtime hotfix to make fallback stateless for that route for the next 20m (ttl=0). Would that help?
sre-oncall: Yes, set sticky_fallback to false for route /api/generate in smart-routing policy. Also flush affinity cache for sessions already sticky.
maya: Affinity cache flush command: ```
# invalidate affinity for route
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/affinity/flush -d '{"route":"/api/generate","scope":"eu-west"}'
```
sriram: I'm running the flush now. Also scaling up eu-west routing pool by +2 instances to soak errors.
jules-cs: Heads up — Support is already getting customer reports. We have 6 customers with elevated error rates, one enterprise customer (AcmeCo) reported timeouts. I'll open a proactive incident email.
nick-pm: What is the customer impact? need numbers for the exec update.\oliver: From metrics: overall 1.8% of requests for /api/generate hit fallback-induced errors in last 15m, error rate peak 12% in eu-west canary cohort. Estimated customers affected: 6-8. No revenue-impact alerts yet.
sre-oncall: Timeline/mitigation checklist: 1) Pause rollout — done. 2) Flush affinity cache — in progress. 3) Toggle sticky_fallback=false — action queued. 4) Scale routing pool — done. 5) Rollback model variant if degradation persists.
incident-bot: Action required: oncall acknowledge & run runbook "fallback-loop-mitigation"
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Running runbook steps. First check: fail rates per variant: ````
variant v3: 0.8% errors
variant v4(canary): 7.2% errors
fallback to eu-west-compat: 9.1% errors
````
maya: The v4 artifact included a subtle tokenization change that can cause decoding errors under long context. That explains mismatch for some sessions.
eng-runner: Suggestion: mark v4 as "incompatible" in catalog temporarily so smart-routing won't route to it at all (force fallback to stable v3). I can flip that flag.
sre-oncall: Do it. But be careful: forcing fallback may increase load on v3; ensure capacity.
eng-runner: Flipped catalog flag for v4 -> status: quarantined. Routing updated.
sriram: Affinity flush complete; sticky TTL set to 0 for /api/generate in eu-west.
nick-pm: Customer message drafted by Jules: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts; we've paused the rollout and applied mitigations; no data loss; will follow up in 60m." Approve?\jules-cs: sending now.
sre-oncall: Monitoring post-mitigation metrics... fallback_rate down from 42% -> 3% over 10m. error_rate for /api/generate down to 0.9%.
oliver: Nice work. Next steps: 1) keep rollout paused 2) create a hotfix branch for tokenization regression 3) test v4 against long-context prompt suite before re-enabling canary 4) postmortem owner: sriram + maya + oliver.
incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0421-001; severity: P2; responders: sriram,maya,oliver,sre-oncall
sre-oncall: Handing off to follow-up rotation. I'll leave monitoring on for 2 hours then hand to daytime SRE.
sriram: I'll take postmortem doc and start notes. Assigning follow-ups: fix tokenization regression (eng-runner), add rollout pre-check for long-context tests (maya), limit sticky_fallback TTL default to 5m (policy team).
oliver: Any outstanding customer issues?\jules-cs: AcmeCo had transient errors but accepted the proactive note. No escalations.
nick-pm: Good. Schedule a brief sync later today for root cause triage. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
